title: Automated Manual Transmission
text: 理想自动机械变速器，输入 5 路、输出 3 路；{Control type} 控制类型 Ideal integrated、{Efficiency factors} 指定效率计算 Gear、{Input shaft inertia, Jin} 指定惯性 .01、{Input shaft damping, bin} 指定阻尼 .001、{Initial input velocity, omegain_o} 指定角速度、{Gear number vector, G} 指定变速器挡位数、{Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} 指定断点、{Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} 指定断点、{Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} 指定断点、{Gear ratio vector, N} 指定输入速度与输出速度之比、{Transmission inertia vector, Jout} 指定挡位旋转惯性、{Transmission damping vector, bout} 指定挡位粘性阻尼系数、{Efficiency vector, eta} 指定挡位效率、{Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} 指定挡位效率 array、{Initial output velocity, omegaout_o} 指定变速器、{Initial gear, G_o} 指定已啮合挡位、{Clutch pressure time constant, tauc} 指定时间 .02、{Synchronization time, ts} 指定时间 .25、{Clutch time, tc} 指定时间 .5、{Effective clutch radius, R} 指定半径 .2、{Clutch force gain, K_c} 指定力 5e3、{Clutch static friction coefficient, mus} 指定系数、{Clutch kinematic friction coefficient, muk} 指定系数、{Start simulation with clutch locked} 以初始锁定离合器、{Start simulation with synchronizer locked} 以初始锁定同步器，按实例取值。

ports.name: Gear
ports.summary: 要啮合的挡位编号 scalar

params.name: Control type
params.values: 指定控制类型 Ideal integrated controller (default) | External control

params.name: Efficiency factors
params.values: 指定效率计算 Gear only (default) | Gear, input torque, input speed, and temperature

params.name: Gear number vector, G
params.values: 指定变速器挡位数 [-1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5] (default) | vector

params.name: Gear ratio vector, N
params.values: 输入速度与输出速度之比 [-4.47, 1, 4.47, 2.47, 1.47, 1, 0.8] (default) | vector

params.name: Start simulation with clutch locked
params.values: 选择以初始锁定离合器 off (default) | on

params.name: Start simulation with synchronizer locked
params.values: 选择以初始锁定同步器 off (default) | on
